in_marathi.name: Adarsh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adarsh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adarsh means ideal or model in Sanskrit. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'adarsa', which means 'sight' or 'vision'. Adarsh is a name that signifies perfection and is often given to a child who is considered to be a role model or ideal in some way.
